title: Vendor GitHub SSH keys for paphos/oracle
intent: paphos and oracle nixos-upgrade must never fail because keys on github.com/worldofgeese.keys changed; vendor the key list in-repo instead of a hash-pinned builtins.fetchurl of a mutable URL
proof_hooks: repro: nix eval of paphos kypris keyFiles fails with hash mismatch on main
nix eval paphos+oracle toplevel drvPath succeeds
generated authorized_keys = deployed set + google-pixel-fold key (no key removed)
nixos-upgrade.service succeeds on paphos and oracle after merge; health check clean
stop_conditions: both hosts upgraded and SSH still works
